g.text: Your DAM stays the source of truth.
MAKE produces around it and hands everything back.
This is the answer to integration, data and portability. Assets and intelligence come out of your DAM, production happens in MAKE, and what returns is richer than what left.

THE LINE WE DO NOT CROSS
MAKE never becomes your system of record.
It is where work is produced, not where it lives. Your DAM is complete at every point in
this loop, and it is more complete after each brief than before it.
Portability is one of the three things this section has to answer,
alongside integration and data. This loop is the shape of the
